facts.statement: Visits are counted with Fathom Analytics (site DNBPMMDA), which sets no cookies and stores no personal data; it counts pages read, referring sites, and country, browser and device type as totals.
facts.note: Check Fathom’s compliance page says this for the plan used

facts.statement: Fathom counts visits on geopolitics.tools only, never on previews.
The site is served by Cloudflare, whose servers see each visitor’s IP address and browser details to deliver pages and may keep them briefly in logs.
facts.note: Check how long Cloudflare keeps logs for this plan

facts.statement: The share buttons are plain links to X and Telegram; nothing loads from those sites until a reader clicks.
The site sets no cookies and loads no third-party scripts besides Fathom.
